variants: a build branch whose change reached origin/main as a different (squash) commit, with a clean work folder next to the repo, last touched over a day ago

expect.detail: the branch and its folder are removed one at a time, and the run log records the branch name and the sha it pointed at, so git branch <name> <sha> restores it

variants: a landed branch whose work folder holds an ignored .env file
a landed branch last touched an hour ago

expect.detail: both are kept and the run says why (ignored files present, touched under 24h ago); nothing is removed that might be someone's live work

variants: a landed branch that a card on a board names
a branch with work that is not on origin/main

expect.detail: both branches and the unlanded folder stay, each listed as kept with its reason
